questions.q: What first brought Clinton's personal email account to public attention?
a: A congressional committee found she used it for official business
A rival campaign leaked her private messages
A watchdog group sued for access to her server
A staffer admitted deleting classified files
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a committee investigating Benghazi discovered the personal account.

questions.q: What did FBI director James Comey say about the email case?
a: Her aides were careless, but no charges would be filed
She had obstructed the investigation
Classified files were never found on the server
The case would go before a grand jury
questions.why: Lesson 1 quotes Comey calling the aides careless while declining to charge anyone.

questions.q: Why did later email leaks keep hurting the campaign?
a: The public linked any email story to the scandal
They proved the private server was secure
They showed the FBI had cleared her early
They came from Clinton's own server
questions.why: Lesson 1 says leaked DNC and campaign emails were read as more of the same scandal.

questions.q: How did the Clinton team misjudge Bernie Sanders?
a: They underestimated how much his anti-establishment message resonated
They expected him to switch parties
They assumed his supporters would back her
They thought he lacked money to compete
questions.why: Lesson 2 says the campaign never grasped the anti-establishment mood Sanders tapped.

questions.q: What internal problem does the summary describe in the campaign?
a: Staff hoarded information to protect their own power
Staff agreed too quickly on every decision
Staff refused to meet with the candidate
Staff shared every plan in open meetings
questions.why: Lesson 3 describes leaders keeping intelligence to themselves to hold power.
